title: Tamoxifen Administration for Lineage Tracing Using CreERT2 mice
protocol: Reconstitute tamoxifen stock solution at a concentration of 20 mg/ml in 100% ethanol.
Aliquot 1 ml portions and store at -80°C.
Weigh mice to determine the appropriate dose of tamoxifen based on body weight.
Dissolve tamoxifen stock into corn oil to achieve a final volume of 50 μl per dose.
Vortex the corn oil/ethanol mixture and place in vacuum centrifuge for 30 min to evaporate ethanol.
Aspirate the tamoxifen solution into an insulin syringe.
Inject mice with between 3 and 5 doses of tamoxifen as appropriate for transgenic lines.
Quantify recombination efficiency in a known cell type expressing the gene driving CreER.
Use a chase period of at least 21 days to ensure the absence of residual tamoxifen before injury.
